Service

version 2.0 released at {{ timestamp }}

Recent updates

  • Added multi-tenant support and isolated per-tenant data stores
  • Improved observability with per-request tracing and structured logging
  • Refactored authentication flow to support OIDC + SAML bridge
  • Added rate-limiting middleware with per-endpoint configurable quotas
  • Hardened TLS configuration: only TLS 1.3 enabled, weak ciphers removed
  • Added comprehensive audit log for admin operations
  • Improved database connection pooling and query timeout enforcement
  • Added new API endpoint /v2/assets/bulk for batch asset ingestion
  • Migrated legacy session storage from Redis to SQLite-backed file store
  • Added webhooks for asset change notifications
  • Improved error responses with structured problem+json format
  • Added admin UI for whitelisting source IP ranges

For migration notes see the operator handbook chapter 7.
